documents.question: How do I earn Kalettes?
documents.answer: Complete your quarterly assessment to earn Kalettes from your active policy. Your Longevity Level sets your rebate: level 1 is 1% of your monthly premium back, level 10 is 10%. Each Kalette is worth 1p (£0.01). Points start as pending and move into your spendable balance when you complete your next assessment on time.

documents.question: Why must I complete an assessment to bank?
documents.answer: Banking only on assessment makes the link between training and reward concrete. Skip one and your accrued points reset — but your fitness doesn't, so the next cycle pays even more.

documents.question: When do points expire?
documents.answer: Banked points last 24 months from the date they were awarded. We'll nudge you well before any expire.

documents.question: Can I gift my points?
documents.answer: Not yet — but it's coming. For now, points can only be redeemed at kale.co/rewards by the policyholder.
